document.abstract: Concerning the optical theory of the rotating prism in high-speed cameras, there have been Letters to the Editor published in the Journal in July 1951. As the Letters dealt with more or less controversial interpretations of the problems involved in conventional high-speed camera design, I am glad to have this opportunity to expand upon the applications of the basic principles to the definite possibility of a promising and perhaps unexpected development in this field. It is necessary, however, to start with a survey of the existing commercial types.
